Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting property owners from injury caused to another person as a result of metal theft.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to exempting property owners from injury caused toanother person as a result of metal theft; and adding a new section tochapter 4.24 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 4.24 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A public or private landowner is not liable for unintentionalinjuries to any person when the injury is caused by the theft ofcopper, aluminum, steel, or other metal material from property owned bythe landowner.
